guideTitle: The Best Standing Desks With Built-In Power, and Alternatives Worth Considering
breadcrumbLabel: Best Standing Desks With Power Outlets
metaTitle: Best Standing Desks With Built-In Power Outlets and USB-C (2026)
metaDescription: Only one desk here confirms built-in outlets and USB-C. We explain what to check on it, and compare seven alternatives that need a separate power strip.
introParagraphs: Built-in power is less common on standing desks than search results suggest. Of the eight desks here, only the Huuger 47 x 24 confirms power outlets and a USB-C port in its listing. The other seven are included as alternatives with other strengths, such as drawers, keyboard trays, depth or width, and each is clearly marked as having no confirmed outlet.

Even a confirmed outlet raises questions the listing may not answer: whether it has surge protection (none here state it), how many watts the USB-C port delivers, and whether the cord has enough slack for the desk's full height range. A clamp-on power strip with surge protection is often the more flexible solution.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $95 to $200 at the time of writing.

huuger-power-outlets-usb-c-standing-desk.summary: A 47 x 24-inch electric desk with built-in power outlets and a USB-C port.
huuger-power-outlets-usb-c-standing-desk.description:
The Huuger 47 x 24 is the one desk here that confirms built-in power outlets and a USB-C port in its listing, so it is the pick if integrated power is a requirement.

It is a compact electric desk with four height presets on a steel frame, for about $105 at the time of writing.

The listing does not state surge protection or USB-C wattage, so treat the outlets as pass-through power and do not assume the USB-C port will charge a laptop. It has fewer buyer reviews than several desks here.
cons: Surge protection and USB-C wattage not stated
huuger-power-outlets-usb-c-standing-desk.bestFor: Buyers who want outlets and USB-C on the desk itself.
huuger-power-outlets-usb-c-standing-desk.skipIf: You need a larger surface; pair a larger desk here with a clamp-on power strip.

aodk-55-drawers-keyboard-tray-power-refe.summary: A 55-inch desk with drawers and a keyboard tray; no built-in outlet confirmed.
aodk-55-drawers-keyboard-tray-power-refe.description:
The AODK does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is here for its storage: a 55-inch standing desk with drawers and a keyboard tray, both confirmed in the listing.

If you want power at the desk, add a clamp-on or under-desk power strip, and check that it does not clash with the drawers.
aodk-55-drawers-keyboard-tray-power-refe.bestFor: Buyers who want storage and will add their own power strip.
aodk-55-drawers-keyboard-tray-power-refe.skipIf: Built-in power is required; choose the Huuger 47 x 24.

offigo-55-u-shaped-keyboard-tray-power-r.summary: A 55-inch U-shaped desk with a keyboard tray; no built-in outlet confirmed.
offigo-55-u-shaped-keyboard-tray-power-r.description:
The OffiGo U-shaped desk does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is included for its wraparound layout and keyboard tray, and it is well rated by buyers.

Plan on a separate power strip if you need outlets within reach.
offigo-55-u-shaped-keyboard-tray-power-r.bestFor: Buyers who value layout and a tray over integrated power.

huuger-55x28-power-reference.summary: A 55 x 28-inch Huuger desk with the deepest top here; no outlet confirmed.
huuger-55x28-power-reference.description:
This Huuger is a different model from the outlet-equipped 47 x 24, and its listing does not mention built-in power. Do not assume shared features across a brand.

Its 27.6-inch depth is the deepest here, useful for monitor arms and larger setups, and it includes two hooks and three height presets.
huuger-55x28-power-reference.bestFor: Buyers who want more depth and will add a power strip.
huuger-55x28-power-reference.skipIf: You want built-in power; the smaller Huuger 47 x 24 has it.

offigo-63-l-shaped-drawers-power-referen.summary: A 63-inch L-shaped desk with four drawers; no built-in outlet confirmed.
offigo-63-l-shaped-drawers-power-referen.description:
The OffiGo L-shaped desk does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is here for its corner layout and four drawers, which give more surface and storage than the straight desks.

With drawers underneath, plan where a power strip will go before setting it up.
offigo-63-l-shaped-drawers-power-referen.bestFor: Corner home offices that want storage.

ergear-48x24-power-reference.badge: No Confirmed Outlet: Best Budget Desk
ergear-48x24-power-reference.summary: A widely reviewed 48 x 24-inch electric desk; no built-in outlet confirmed.
ergear-48x24-power-reference.description:
The ErGear does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is included as the lowest-priced, most widely reviewed desk here, at about $95 at the time of writing.

It is a straightforward 48 x 24-inch electric desk; add a clamp-on power strip if you need outlets.
ergear-48x24-power-reference.bestFor: Budget buyers who will add their own power strip.
ergear-48x24-power-reference.skipIf: Built-in power is required; the Huuger 47 x 24 costs about $10 more.

fezibo-48x24-power-reference.summary: A 48 x 24-inch desk with a maple splice-board top; no built-in outlet confirmed.
fezibo-48x24-power-reference.description:
The FEZIBO does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is here for its white frame and maple splice-board top, a lighter look than the black or brown desks.

It is well reviewed; pair it with a separate power strip for outlets.
fezibo-48x24-power-reference.bestFor: Buyers who want a lighter-looking desk and will add a power strip.

veken-55-power-reference.summary: A 55-inch electric desk for dual monitors; no built-in outlet confirmed.
veken-55-power-reference.description:
The Veken does not confirm a built-in outlet. It is included as a wide 55-inch desk for dual monitors at a moderate price.

A wider desk may need a longer power strip cable to reach all your equipment.
veken-55-power-reference.bestFor: Dual-monitor setups that will add a power strip.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Check the specific listing. Only the Huuger 47 x 24 confirms outlets here; the Huuger 55 x 28 from the same brand does not.
None of the listings state it. For monitors and computers, a surge-protected strip is the safer assumption.
Desk USB-C ports vary widely in power. If the wattage is not listed, do not count on it charging a laptop.
The power cord must reach the wall outlet at the desk's highest setting without strain. Check after assembly.
Size, depth, drawers and trays matter as much as power, and a clamp-on strip can add outlets to any desk.

faq.q: Which desks here have built-in outlets?
faq.a: Only the Huuger 47 x 24 confirms built-in outlets and USB-C. The other seven do not.

faq.q: Do built-in desk outlets have surge protection?
faq.a: None of the listings here state it. Use a surge-protected power strip for sensitive equipment.

faq.q: How much power does a desk USB-C port deliver?
faq.a: It varies widely by desk. The Huuger listing does not state its wattage, so confirm with the seller before relying on it for a laptop.

faq.q: Do all desks from one brand share the same features?
faq.a: No. The Huuger 55 x 28 does not list the outlets found on the Huuger 47 x 24.

faq.q: Will the power cord cope with the desk's height range?
faq.a: Only if it has enough slack. Raise the desk to its highest setting after setup and check the cord is not pulled tight.

faq.q: How do I add power to a desk without outlets?
faq.a: A clamp-on or under-desk power strip, ideally surge-protected, adds outlets to any of these desks.

bottomLine: If built-in power is essential, the Huuger 47 x 24 is the only confirmed choice here; check its USB-C wattage and add surge protection if your equipment needs it.

Otherwise, choose the desk you want and add a clamp-on power strip: the ErGear for the lowest price, the AODK or OffiGo desks for storage and trays, the Huuger 55 x 28 for depth, or the Veken for width.
